Title: Reduction of Metacholine-Induced Nasal Secretion by Treatment with a New Topical Steroid in Perennial Non-Allergic Rhinitis
Author: L. Malm, J. Å. Wihl, C. J. Lamm, and N. Lindqvist
Comment: Crossover trial: the same 22 participants received each preparation. The placebo event count of zero follows from the Results statement that no side effects were reported during placebo treatment. The 200 µg/day and placebo denominators are based on the 22 completers described as participating in the study and receiving each preparation; no outcome-specific missing denominator was reported. No risk difference was reported by the paper and none was calculated.; group_1/group_2 fields swapped: the extractor itself stated group_1_label ('Budesonide 200 µg/day intranasally') is the intervention arm (group_1_is_control=False)
Study Environment: Clinical treatment periods with daily patient recording and hospital follow-up visits
Topic of Content: Intranasal budesonide treatment for perennial non-allergic rhinitis
Participant type: Adults aged 20–68 years with perennial non-allergic rhinitis
Outcome measurement: Side effects recorded daily by patients
effect_direction: Higher risk of epistaxis with intranasal corticosteroid than placebo

Title: Mometasone Furoate Nasal Spray in the Treatment of Perennial Non-allergic Rhinitis: A Nordic, Multicenter, Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Study
Author: Lundblad, Sipilä, Farstad, and Drozdziewicz
Comment: The supplied pre-identified effect explicitly gives safety denominators of 169 for MFNS and 162 for placebo. These sum to 331, whereas the Results analysis states ITT N=329 and efficacy tables show 167 MFNS and 162 placebo. Table IV itself displays event counts and percentages but not denominators. Values were preserved as supplied for the adverse-event effect; this denominator discrepancy should be checked against the original typeset article. The dose appears as '200 mg' in OCR-corrupted prose, while the extraction contract identifies the intended eligible dose as 200 µg/day.; group_1/group_2 fields swapped: the extractor itself stated group_1_label ('Mometasone furoate nasal spray (MFNS) 200 µg once daily') is the intervention arm (group_1_is_control=False)
Design Type: Phase III multicenter randomized double-blind placebo-controlled parallel-group trial
Study Environment: 16 clinical sites in Sweden, Denmark, Finland, and Norway
Content length: 6 weeks of double-blind treatment with 3 weeks of follow-up
Topic of Content: Treatment and safety of mometasone furoate nasal spray for perennial non-allergic rhinitis
Participant type: Adults aged 18–82 years with perennial non-allergic rhinitis
Outcome type: Dichotomous adverse event: participant experienced epistaxis
Outcome measurement: Adverse events were tabulated and summarized; the specific ascertainment method for epistaxis was not stated
effect_direction: Higher risk of epistaxis with intranasal corticosteroid than placebo
